mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which compresses equity risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises sequentially for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% annualized signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized rate exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a strong labor market with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive equity returns through elevated corporate hiring and consumer spending.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * FEDFUNDS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window during periods of simultaneous PAYEMS growth and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly) in late-cycle expansion regimes signals overcapacity risk and imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% during late-cycle expansion regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing risk-free rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 7.0% signals labor market tightness that triggers inflation expectations and monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) expansion indicates robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The interaction term (GDPC1 * INDPRO) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window during periods of simultaneous GDP and INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) in post-recession recovery regimes signals accelerating consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through near-term earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises sequentially for 3 consecutive months during post-recession recovery regimes.
